 Highly Regarded
   

  

* Financial services or regulated environment experience
* Exposure to AI governance, model risk, and security frameworks
* Experience in real\-time/streaming AI systems

title: Internal Systems Engineer
description:
Big Wave Digital is partnering with one of our premier scaling technology clients in Sydney CBD, and this is one of those roles where the timing could be seriously interesting.
 



 The business is growing quickly. The platform is evolving. The internal technology environment is becoming more complex, more important, and much more strategic.
 



  





 So yes, this is
 **5 days a week on\-site** 
 .
 



  





 But this is not a beige back\-office IT role where your biggest achievement is resetting Dave from Accounts’ password for the 14th time.
 



 This is a hands\-on
 **Platform Engineer / Systems Engineer** 
 role where you will help own, build and improve the
 **internal tooling and systems layer** 
 of a fast\-scaling technology business. You will work across SaaS platforms, identity, access, integrations, security posture, automation, migrations and ongoing platform ownership.
 



 In short: you will help build the internal systems engine room before this business shifts into hyperspace.
 



 As Han Solo nearly said: “Never tell me the odds.”
 



 Actually, do tell us the odds. Then automate the reporting through an API.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for a strong
 **Senior Platform Engineer / Systems Engineer** 
 who understands modern SaaS\-first technology environments and knows how to build, operate and improve them properly.
 



 This role sits right at the intersection of
 **internal tooling, SaaS platform ownership, identity, automation and security** 
 .
 



 You will not just administer tools.
 



 You will own them.
 



 You will audit, select, implement, operate, maintain and improve the internal tooling ecosystem that helps the business move faster, operate securely and scale cleanly.
 



 This is ideal for someone who sits somewhere between:
 



**Systems Engineer** 




**Internal Platform Engineer** 




**SaaS Platform Engineer** 




**Identity / IAM Engineer** 




**Security\-minded IT Operations Engineer** 




 Not pure DevOps. Not pure cyber. Not helpdesk. Not traditional infrastructure.
 



 This is modern internal platform engineering for a scaling tech company.
 



 What You’ll Be Owning
 



 Internal Tooling and SaaS Platform Ownership
 



 You will work across the company’s core internal tooling stack, helping ensure the systems environment is scalable, secure, well\-integrated and fit for a growing business.
 



 That includes platform ownership across tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, ClickUp, Notion, Confluence, HubSpot and Intercom.
 



 You will be involved in tool consolidation, platform governance, maintenance, configuration, vendor coordination, rollout planning and ongoing improvement.
 



 The client wants someone who can
 **build and operate** 
 , not just advise from the sidelines.
 



  





 “Stay on target.”
 



  





 Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace Migration
 



 A key part of the role is ownership around a major
 **Office 365 to Google Workspace migration** 
 , including the SSO / IdP rollout and the tool consolidation that sits behind it.
 



 So, if you have led a significant SaaS migration before, particularly M365 to Google Workspace or Google Workspace to M365, this will be highly relevant.
 



 This is not just mailbox movement.
 



 This is identity, access, tooling, workflow, business adoption, integrations, security and stakeholder communication all wrapped into one.
 



 Identity, SSO and Federation
 



 Identity is a major part of this role.
 



 You will work across:
 



  




* SAML
* OIDC
* SCIM provisioning
* Okta
* RBAC
* Joiner/mover/leaver automation
* SaaS access lifecycle management
* Identity federation across multiple internal tools



  





 This means you need to understand identity properly.
 



 Not just “I’ve created users in Google Admin.”
 



 More like:
 



 “I can design, implement and operate clean identity flows across a modern SaaS estate without turning access management into a swamp creature.”
 



 SaaS Integrations and Automation
 



 You will help design and manage integration architecture between SaaS platforms using APIs, webhooks and automation.
 



 This could involve:
 


* Connecting systems cleanly
* Reducing manual admin
* Improving provisioning and deprovisioning
* Automating workflows
* Building lightweight scripts
* Improving data flow between business tools
* Making the internal tooling stack less clunky and more scalable



 Experience with Python, PowerShell, bash, API integrations, Jira automation, Okta workflows or similar would all be useful.
 



 Basically, if your instinct is “surely we can automate this instead of doing it manually forever,” you are probably our kind of person.
 



 Security Posture and Access Hygiene
 



  





 This role has a strong security flavour, but it is not a pure cyber security role.
 



 You will focus heavily on:
 


* Least privilege
* Secrets management
* Passwords
* API keys
* Certificates
* RBAC
* Access reviews
* Audit trail hygiene
* SaaS security posture
* Access governance



 So, while this is not a SOC / SIEM / incident response role, it absolutely needs someone who thinks carefully about risk, permissions, access and operational security.
 



 The Death Star had one open exhaust port.
 



 Let’s not build internal systems like that.
 



  





 What You’ll Need
 



 You will need strong experience across modern internal systems and SaaS\-first environments.
 



 Ideally, you will bring:
 


* 5\+ years’ systems engineering experience in a SaaS\-first environment
* End\-to\-end ownership across building and operating platforms
* Experience leading at least one major SaaS migration
* Strong Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 technical depth
* SSO / IdP implementation experience
* SAML, OIDC, SCIM and RBAC experience
* Okta experience, ideally
* Strong understanding of joiner/mover/leaver workflows
* SaaS integration experience using APIs, webhooks or automation
* Strong internal tooling experience across a modern SaaS stack
* Strong security mindset around access, secrets, audit hygiene and least privilege
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills
* Ability to scope, plan, execute and own outcomes
* Confidence translating technical decisions for non\-technical business teams



 So you need to know your craft.
 



 And just as importantly, you need to be able to explain it clearly.
 



 Nice\-to\-Have Experience
 



 Any of the following would be a bonus:
 


* AWS or broader cloud infrastructure experience
* Docker or containerised tooling
* 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or similar
* MDM / device management tools such as Jamf, Intune, Kandji or NinjaOne
* Python, PowerShell or bash scripting
* Fintech, trading, SaaS or regulated industry experience
* HubSpot, Intercom or Meraki implementation experience
* ITIL background, provided you still enjoy moving quickly



 The current stack includes Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, ClickUp, Notion, Confluence, 1Password, Okta, AWS, Cloudflare, GitHub, HubSpot and Intercom.
 



  





 Who This Is Not For
 



 Let’s be upfront, because nobody has time for recruitment theatre.
 



 This is probably not the right role if you are:
 


* Mainly L1 / L2 helpdesk
* Mainly end\-user desktop support
* A pure AI engineer or prompt engineer
* A traditional on\-prem infrastructure engineer without recent SaaS platform depth
* Looking for a people management role
* Looking for remote or hybrid work
* A pure DevOps engineer expecting Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD as the core role
* A pure cyber security engineer expecting SOC, SIEM, threat detection or incident response



  





 This is for someone who loves modern internal tooling, SaaS systems, identity, automation, integrations, access governance and security\-minded engineering.
 



 The Person We’re Looking For
 



 You are probably someone who has worked in a fast\-growing SaaS, fintech, technology or product\-led business.
 



  





 What matters is what you have actually owned.
 



 If you have been responsible for internal tooling across Okta, Google Workspace, M365, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Notion, HubSpot, Intercom, MDM, automation workflows, access governance and identity platforms, then we should probably talk.
 



 You will be a strong communicator, technically credible, calm under pressure and comfortable working with both engineers and business stakeholders.
 



 You do not need to be loud.
 



 You do need to be clear.
 



 You need to be able to walk into a scaling environment, understand the moving pieces, build trust quickly and start making things better.
 



 Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention
 



 Because timing matters.
 



 Joining a scaling tech business before everything is perfectly formed can be a brilliant career move.
 



 You get to shape things.
 



 You get to own meaningful work.
 



 You get to solve real internal tooling and platform problems.
 



 You get to work closely with sharp technical people while the company is still building the systems, processes and operating rhythm that will support its next stage of growth.
 



 Yes, it is 5 days a week on\-site in Sydney CBD.
 



 But for the right person, that is part of the opportunity. You will be close to the action, close to the decision\-makers, and part of the momentum.
 



 This is not a role for someone who wants to sit quietly in the outer rim.
 



 This is for someone ready to jump on the train while the engines are still roaring.
 



 Or, in slightly more intergalactic terms:
 



 “The Force will be with you. Always.”
 



 The Details
 



**Title:** 
 Senior Platform Engineer / Systems Engineer
 



**Focus:** 
 Internal Tooling, SaaS Platforms, Identity, Security, Integrations
 



**Location:** 
 Sydney CBD
 



**Work pattern:** 
 5 days a week on\-site
 



**Salary:** 
 Circa $180k \+ super \+ bonus
 



**Company:** 
 Scaling technology platform business
 



**Recruiter:** 
 Big Wave Digital
 



 About Big Wave Digital
 



 Big Wave Digital partners with some of Australia’s most exciting technology, digital, AI, data, product and marketing businesses.
 



 We love what we do. Properly.
 



 We care about quality, fit, communication and long\-term relationships. We do not believe in throwing CVs at a wall and hoping one sticks. We believe in understanding the role, understanding the person and making the right match.
 



 We work with scaling tech companies, fintechs, AI\-led businesses, digital platforms and product\-driven organisations across Sydney and beyond.
 



 So, whether you are a brilliant
 **Platform Engineer / Systems Engineer** 
 looking for your next mission, or a company looking to hire exceptional technology talent, you know where to look.
 



**Big Wave Digital.** 




 Not quite a Jedi Council.
 



 But close enough.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Senior AI Engineer \- Oceania Tax Technology \- CTO Tax Office \- EY Rank of Senior Manager or Associate Director**
**The opportunity**
 EY is on the lookout for a technically adept and visionary technologist to take on the role of Senior AI Engineer, with a focus on delivering cutting\-edge AI solutions. As our Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the experimentation, prototyping and deployment of advanced AI and Generative AI solutions. Working with leading foundation models and orchestration frameworks, you will translate emerging capabilities into practical, commercially viable solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be at the forefront of designing and executing innovative GenAI solutions and will provide technical guidance to a team of skilled and junior data scientists and engineers. This role demands a strong combination of technical prowess, sector\-specific insight and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with senior tax executives, work closely with our Tax business, and partner with EY’s technology teams and platforms to deliver practical, commercially viable solutions.
   

  

 You’ll design and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI applications that transform business processes and deliver measurable impact for EY clients. Here’s where you’ll make your mark:
   

  

* LLM\-powered solutions and agentic AI workflows
* Data\-driven architectures across cloud and on\-prem environments
* Scalable, production\-ready systems with Responsible AI compliance


 You’ll be part of our Tax Technology team within the Office of the CTO, driving innovation and applying modern frameworks to deliver enterprise\-grade AI solutions.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate expertise in AI/ML and Generative AI, including hands\-on experience with leading LLMs (such as OpenAI and Anthropic), prompt engineering, and low\-code platforms.
* Apply knowledge of Agentic Systems, including multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, and leveraging low\-code technologies.
* Lead the prototyping and deployment of AI and Generative AI solutions to support client engagements and scalable offerings across sectors.
* Collaborate with EY Tax Leadership and engage with Heads of Tax, CTOs, and CDOs to explore and deliver technical generative AI solutions.
* Maintain advanced knowledge of AI solution architecture and data science methodologies to design innovative solutions.
* Act as a technical thought leader by emphasising the impact of data and AI in transforming tax organisations and solving complex challenges.
* Support go\-to\-market strategies for GenAI services by offering technical insights and integrating AI solutions within EY's broader service offerings.

* Knowledge of Agentic Systems, such as multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, and low\-code platforms
* At least 12 years of professional experience, predominantly in a technical leadership role within the data science/AI field.
* Demonstrable success in designing and deploying AI solutions, with a preference for experience in the Financial Services and Tax industries.
* In\-depth knowledge of AI solution architecture and data science, with practical experience in these domains.
* Up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in generative AI, data fabrics, and data transformation technologies.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related technical field.
* Professional certifications in AI, data science, or related technical fields are highly regarded.


**Leadership attributes**
* Proven leadership and team development skills, with a track record of managing high\-performing technical teams.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining intricate technical details to a non\-technical audience.
* Strong interpersonal abilities, adept at forging relationships and influencing technical decision\-making.
* Strategic and analytical thinker with a problem\-solving mindset focused on technical innovation.

* Awareness of Responsible AI \& Security, including ethical AI principles, compliance frameworks, and guardrails for sensitive use cases.
* Proficiency in Programming, especially advanced Python, API development, and solid software engineering practices; front\-end exposure (React/TypeScript) is a bonus.
* Curiosity and adaptability to learn emerging technologies and frameworks quickly.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and ability to work collaboratively in dynamic environments.

* Salary: We offer a competitive salary which is open to negotiation depending on skills and experience.

 Fluency is looking for an AI Engineer to own the AI quality and the prompts, agents, evals, and pipelines behind user\-facing features that ship to Fortune 500 users.
   

  

 Our Customers
   

  

 Customers include CVS Health, Aon, and PVH.
   

  

 Location

* Technical documents, logs, tickets, procedures, specifications

* Technical documentation generation

description:
ON.energy is building the power infrastructure that makes the AI era possible. As AI demand surges past what the grid and traditional data centers can support, ON.energy provides a new class of power technology proven at gigawatt scale and trusted by the world’s leading cloud and AI companies. Our systems are already deployed across 2\.5 GW of hyper\-scale campuses, validated by top U.S. national labs, and certified for grid\-safe operation by major utilities. With real products in the field, we’re scaling faster than the grid can, transforming power from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage for the companies building the future.
   

  

 ON.energy is investing in AI as a horizontal capability across the business, from corporate functions to field operations and OT environments. We're standing up a small team to drive adoption, and we're hiring an AI Engineer to build the systems that make it real.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with our Program Manager, AI Enablement, who owns the roadmap and drives adoption across departments. Your job is to ship: prototype quickly, harden what works, and build the technical patterns the rest of the company will reuse. This is a hands\-on builder role with high visibility. The CTO is the executive sponsor for AI Enablement, your work will be in front of executives regularly, and the systems you ship will touch most of the company within your first year.
   

  

**Responsibilities Will Include**
* Building production AI systems end to end, from prototype through deploy and monitor
* Working directly with stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, HR, Finance, and Commercial to translate workflow problems into shippable tools
* Writing the evaluation harnesses, prompts, retrieval logic, and integration code that make LLM\-powered features reliable
* Establishing reusable technical patterns: prompt and model governance, eval frameworks, data access, deploy practices
* Contributing to the technical roadmap, including where to invest, what to kill, and what's worth building in\-house versus buying
* Supporting the Program Manager on technical scoping for new use cases, including calling out when an out\-of\-the\-box tool will solve the problem versus when custom work is justified


**Requirements**
* Strong CS or related technical degree, with hands\-on production experience building AI/ML systems (internships, research, or full\-time work all count)
* Demonstrated ability to ship: a portfolio of projects or work history that shows you take things from idea to running system, not just notebooks
* Solid software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, code review, and deployment practices
* Working knowledge of modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, RAG, evaluation, agent frameworks, vector stores
* Strong written and verbal communication. You'll be in front of non\-technical stakeholders regularly and the work needs to translate
* Comfortable in ambiguity. We don't have a fully scoped roadmap; you'll help build it


**Preferred Experience**
* Production experience with hosted LLM platforms (Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent)
* Hands\-on experience with Claude Code, MCP server development, or agentic coding tools
* Familiarity with Microsoft ecosystem integration (Entra ID, Graph API, M365 surfaces) for enterprise AI deployments
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks or multi\-agent systems
* Exposure to settings where data sensitivity and operational safety constrain what you can deploy (OT, healthcare, finance, regulated industries)
* Background in energy, utilities, or other operationally complex sectors


**For US\-based Roles \- What You’ll Get**
* Competitive salary \+ annual performance\-based bonus eligibility
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and company holidays


**For Mexico\-based Roles \- What You’ll Get**
* Competitive salary \+ annual performance bonus eligibility
* Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days
* Major medical expenses and life insurance
* Paid time off and holidays (per local policy)


**For All Roles**
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* Opportunity to grow with a mission\-driven team shaping the future of clean energy
* Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.
* Accommodations: If you need an accommodation during the application process, email recruitment@onenergystorage.com
* Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change.

 You’ll contribute to challenging projects using modern technologies, while continuously learning alongside experienced colleagues in an environment built on knowledge sharing, curiosity, and craftsmanship. Combining technical excellence with a human\-centered approach, you’ll help design solutions that truly make a difference for both clients and their users.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You are part of a growing team of talented developers and AI engineers based in Louvain\-la\-Neuve, Brussels or Leuven, who have already successfully completed consulting engagements for renowned Clients in various industries (energy, automotive, drones, pharmaceutical, healthcare, chemicals, mobility, environment, etc.) from small to large\-sized companies.
   

  

* You design and develop the best IT solutions for our Clients, using mainly top notch Open Source programming technologies.
* You analyse available data by leveraging advanced data processing and statistical techniques, and help defining new data needs and collection strategies.
* You design, build and improve machine learning algorithms using most recent technologies in AI (Transformer based language models, image recognition/segmentation models, reinforcement learning algorithms,…) . You actively contribute to the deployment of those algorithms to production environments in close collaboration with our software development teams.
* You help your team in understanding, structuring and challenging our Clients' needs by participating in various business development and iteration meetings.
* You learn every day in the context of different projects. You leverage coaching from more experienced colleagues and also share your experience and skills with your colleagues (pair programming).

* You are regularly in contact with Client representatives (face\-to\-face meetings, emails, phone calls) to present the latest results or advances of the solutions we develop.


**Who You Are**
* You hold a PhD degree in STEM (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, etc.) or a Master's degree with a minimum of three years of professional experience.
* You have experience applying robust data processing and analysis techniques (descriptive statistics, statistical tests, regression, visualisation, etc.) to answer complex scientific and/or business questions.

* You are familiar with standard coding tools (Git, IDEs, etc.).
* You have very good communication skills (oral and written) in English and in at least one of the two national languages (French or Dutch).
* You can be described as an analytical\-minded person. You are curious and want to understand how things work beneath the surface.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Senior AI Engineer — NetSpeek**
NetSpeek is the **agentic control plane for enterprise physical infrastructure**. We govern how AI agents reason about, decide on, and execute actions across enterprise endpoints. Our reasoning and execution layer — Lena — sits in customer production environments, where reliability, observability, and auditability are non\-negotiable.


The Senior AI Engineer owns Lena's reasoning layer end\-to\-end: retrieval, grounding, evaluation, and the boundary between AI suggestions and governed actions.


What you'll work on* Designing and improving RAG pipelines for grounding Lena's diagnostic reasoning in structured operational telemetry, device state, and product documentation.
* Building evaluation harnesses that measure groundedness, hallucination, refusal calibration, and action accuracy on every release.
* Setting the boundary between Lena's probabilistic reasoning and the platform's deterministic action layer — what she's allowed to do, when, and under what audit.
* Owning AI cost and latency budgets per workflow.
* Partnering with backend (.NET) and platform engineers to land changes safely.

**You're a fit if**

* You have 5\+ years of ML / applied AI engineering experience.
* You've built and shipped production LLM systems (RAG, agents, structured outputs, evaluations) at a B2B SaaS company.
* You've owned a production RAG system end\-to\-end.
* You've built evaluation pipelines that ran on every release and caught real regressions.
* You've worked at a growth\-stage AI\-native SaaS company where AI was the primary product.

 **You probably aren't a fit if**

* Your AI exposure stops at experimentation or coursework.
* You haven't deployed AI systems to customer production environments.
* You want a process\-heavy environment where decisions go through committees.


How to apply
Run the Incident Lab scenario for this role, then submit your structured response with the application. Or take the Field Note path as a single essay question instead.


Either path is read by a human on our hiring team. No AI scoring, no auto\-rejection.


Read the Engineering Handbook and How We Evaluate before applying.  

  

After an offer
We run standard pre\-employment checks before your start date: identity verification, right\-to\-work confirmation, employment verification, and (where lawful and role\-relevant) a criminal record check. We don't run credit checks or online reputation scoring.

 **Requirements**  

  

Must\-have* 5\+ years in machine learning engineering, or 5\+ years combined across ML and applied AI systems
* 2\+ years building and shipping LLM\-powered systems in a growth\-phase AI SaaS company where AI was the product, not a side feature
* Hands\-on experience with RAG systems including vector databases, embedding tuning, and retrieval optimization
* Experience building evaluation pipelines for LLM performance, hallucination, and reliability in production
* Strong Python with production\-level ML system implementation
* Track record operating under real product constraints: latency, cost, observability, and safety
* Comfortable being accountable for AI behavior in production


Strong signal* Designed agentic workflows with measurable performance improvements
* Worked at AI\-native startups that scaled from early traction to growth stage
* Reduced hallucination and improved grounding in production systems
* Cost optimization at scale, including token modeling and caching strategies
* Familiarity with compliance\-aware AI logging and enterprise audit requirements
* Defined evaluation pipelines before feature release rather than after


Not the right fit if* Your LLM experience is limited to experimentation, side projects, or non\-production systems
* You are a backend engineer looking to pivot into AI
* Your background is research\-focused without production ownership
* Your AI work has not operated under real customer impact

  

**Benefits**  

We are growth\-stage and fully remote, not late\-stage. We invest in the work, the tools, and the people, not the manifesto.

**What that looks like in practice:**

  

* Flexible / unlimited time off
* Health insurance
* Equity participation, discussed at offer

* Direct working relationships with the people setting platform strategy
* A growth\-stage platform where the decisions you make in your first year shape the product for years
* AI\-assisted tooling licensed by NetSpeek (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable)

title: AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer — NetSpeek**
NetSpeek is the **agentic control plane for enterprise physical infrastructure**. We govern how AI agents reason about, decide on, and execute actions across enterprise endpoints. Our reasoning and execution layer — Lena — sits in customer production environments, where reliability, observability, and auditability are non\-negotiable.


The AI Engineer builds the retrieval, evaluation, and workflow plumbing that makes Lena reliable. You'll work alongside the Senior AI Engineer on the reasoning layer, and across the team on integration into the broader platform.


What you'll work on* Building and tuning RAG components: chunking strategy, retrieval scoring, prompt scaffolding, grounding heuristics.
* Wiring evaluation harnesses that catch regressions on every release.
* Working on the Python services that mediate between Lena and the rest of the platform.
* Working with backend (.NET) and frontend (React) engineers to land AI\-affecting changes safely.

**You're a fit if**

* You have 1\+ years of software / ML engineering experience.
* You're advanced in Python.
* You've shipped Python code that real users relied on (production or internal stakeholders).
* You've worked hands\-on with LLMs, RAG, or AI workflows beyond tutorials.
* You're comfortable with REST APIs and JSON\-based integrations.

**You probably aren't a fit if**

* Your AI work is mostly coursework or side projects without production exposure.
* You want a heavily structured environment with predefined work queues.


How to apply
Run the Improve the RAG for this role, then submit your structured response with the application. Or take the Field Note path as a single essay question instead.


Either path is read by a human on our hiring team. No AI scoring, no auto\-rejection.


Read the Engineering Handbook and How We Evaluate before applying.  

  

After an offer
We run standard pre\-employment checks before your start date: identity verification, right\-to\-work confirmation, employment verification, and (where lawful and role\-relevant) a criminal record check. We don't run credit checks or online reputation scoring.

 **Requirements**  

  

Must\-have* 1–3 years of software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI experience.
* Hands\-on exposure to LLMs, RAG systems, or AI workflows beyond tutorials or coursework.
* Strong Python fundamentals; you have shipped Python that other people relied on.
* Comfort with REST APIs, JSON structures, and modern SaaS systems.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and modern AI tooling.


Strong signal* Designed agentic workflows with measurable performance improvements.
* Exposure to AI\-native startups that scaled from early traction to growth stage.
* Reduced hallucination and improved grounding in production.
* Cost optimization at scale, including token modeling and caching strategies.
* Familiarity with compliance\-aware AI logging and enterprise requirements.

  

**Benefits**  

We are growth\-stage and fully remote, not late\-stage. We invest in the work, the tools, and the people, not the manifesto.

**What that looks like in practice:**

  

* Flexible / unlimited time off
* Health insurance
* Equity participation, discussed at offer
* Fully remote
* Architectural ownership of work that ships to real enterprise customers
* Direct working relationships with the people setting platform strategy
* A growth\-stage platform where the decisions you make in your first year shape the product for years

description:
When data is complex and the mission is critical, law enforcement, intelligence, and security organizations around the world trust JSI. Our 4Sight platform fuses disparate data sources — communications, location, OSINT, financial activity, and more — to expand awareness, surface patterns, and simplify data complexity for the teams that rely on it. AI and machine learning sit at the center of how 4Sight does that work, and the quality of those capabilities has direct, real\-world consequences for the investigations and operations they support.



We are hiring an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two agile AI/ML teams (\~10 engineers total) building production AI capabilities inside our 4Sight platform. You will be accountable for delivery, engineering quality, and team performance, and you will help shape the technical direction in partnership with senior engineering leadership and architects.



This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. We want a manager who still reads code, engages in design discussions, and exercises real judgment on architecture and trade\-offs alongside their teams. You will operate in a fast\-moving AI environment where priorities shift, ambiguity is the norm, and the bar for production reliability is high.



Before you apply: this role requires eligibility for a Government of Canada Top Secret security clearance. The position is based in Kanata, Ontario, with at least two days per week of in\-office collaboration.


#### **Responsibilities:**


**Leadership \& Team Management**


* Lead, manage, and mentor two agile teams of software developers, data scientists, and AI engineers (\~10 direct reports)
* Hire, develop, and retain high\-performing engineering talent
* Conduct performance management, career development, and coaching
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
* Set clear expectations and ensure alignment with team and organizational goals
* Act as an escalation point for team\-level challenges and cross\-team dependencies


**Delivery \& Execution**


* Accountable for the delivery outcomes, engineering quality, and performance of both teams
* Ensure predictable, sustainable delivery practices aligned with business objectives
* Manage scope, risks, and dependencies across concurrent initiatives
* Partner with Product Management to translate business goals into executable plans
* Ensure high\-quality releases and effective handling of production issues and support needs
* Evolve agile practices, testing discipline, and release processes to improve delivery outcomes and team effectiveness over time


**Technical Leadership**


* Set and execute the technical direction for your product area
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to guide design decisions and review critical architecture
* Partner with senior engineers to ensure sound technical execution and maintainability
* Identify and manage technical debt, balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term system health


**AI/ML Execution**


* Lead delivery of AI/ML capabilities across investigative use cases — entity resolution, link analysis, anomaly and pattern detection, NLP on unstructured communications, and similar problems against large, heterogeneous datasets
* Drive the path from experimentation to production: dataset curation, model evaluation against operational metrics, deployment, monitoring for drift, and retraining cycles
* Hold a high bar for model validation in a domain where false positives and false negatives both have real consequences for investigations and the people involved
* Partner with data and platform teams on the infrastructure that makes production ML reliable — feature stores, evaluation harnesses, observability, and lifecycle tooling
* Champion responsible\-AI practices: bias review, explainability where it matters, auditability, and clear human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries

#### **Required Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years managing engineering teams with direct delivery accountability
* Track record of leading teams through ambiguous, evolving roadmaps where the right answer wasn't obvious at the start
* Experience owning production systems end\-to\-end: release quality, on\-call response, and post\-incident learning
* Strong design and architecture judgment — able to engage credibly with senior engineers on technical trade\-offs and push back when warranted

#### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* Direct experience managing AI/ML or data engineering teams, not just teams adjacent to them
* Shipped production ML systems and lived with the operational reality — drift, retraining, evaluation, incident response on model behavior
* Worked with large\-scale data infrastructure: streaming pipelines, distributed processing, feature stores, or comparable
* Background in one or more of: entity resolution, graph/link analysis, NLP, anomaly detection, or geospatial analytics
* Experience in regulated, mission\-critical, or national\-security adjacent environments
* Prior Government of Canada or Five Eyes clearance held in the last 24 months

Founded in 1979, JSI is a trusted provider of lawful intelligence and AI\-enabled analytics to law enforcement, intelligence, and security organizations, with customers in over 30 countries across 6 continents. description:
**We are:**


A forward\-thinking services company at the forefront of AI\-native innovation. We partner with enterprise clients to create next\-generation, agent\-powered workflows engineered to scale in real\-world settings. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, moving projects beyond experimentation into operational reality.

**You are:**


An AI Forward Deployed Engineering with a minimum of 7 years of experience building cloud\-native solutions, and experience in designing and deploying agentic systems, especially for enterprise environments. You are a critical thinker that thrives in ambiguity, delivering concrete results by designing, building, and running custom AI agents that augment workflows and scale across modern infrastructure. You’ll help shape the playbook for how enterprises adopt and scale AI\-native engineering globally.

**The Work:**


You’ll embed directly with clients — acting as both technologist and trusted advisor. You’ll partner with stakeholders to define use cases, rapidly prototype, and deploy agentic workflows that are robust, secure, and operational in complex enterprise domains. Often, these will be completely net new platforms and systems that need to be stitched together in our clients' environments alongside our Ecosystem partners.

**Responsibilities:**

* Agent Architecture and Engineering: Design and engineer enterprise\-ready AI agents encompassing retrieval, orchestration, policy\-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability.
* AI Platform Integration: Develop abstraction layers across AI providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, etc. ) to enable seamless integration and enablement.
* Cloud\-Native Engineering: Leverage containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, event\-driven architectures, CI/CD, and observability to deliver scalable AI\-native systems.
* Domain\-Specific Workflows: Tailor and deploy agentic applications across verticals — e.g., finance, healthcare, retail — addressing domain\-specific processes via intelligent automation.
* Client Engagement: Conduct design workshops, POCs, and code\-with sessions to shape data\-driven agent workflows with stakeholders, fostering trust and adoption.
* Measure \& Improve: Define and use key metrics, test harnesses, and evaluation plans to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost effectiveness.
* Knowledge Sharing: Craft reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices to influence internal assets and client roadmaps.

  

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; additional AI certifications or agentic tool experience is a plus.
* Minimum of 7 years engineering experience with cloud\-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless).
* Minimum of 1 year designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows)
* Minimum of 1 years experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open\-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi\-provider pipelines.
* Minimum of 7 years experience programming in Python, Java, or equivalent; familiarity with evaluation tooling, logging, monitoring, and agent observability.

**Bonus Points If:**

* You’ve served as a Forward Deployed Engineer or an Agentic AI Engineer in an Enterprise environment
* Additional AI certifications or agentic tool experience is a plus.
* You’ve defined or worked with enterprise\-grade architectures for compound AI systems, orchestration frameworks, or agent registry/stream\-based architectures.
* You understand the AI\-native paradigm — blending cloud\-native with generative model architectures — optimizing for performance, modularity, and efficiency.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location,  

role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation, based on full\-time

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
At PhenoTips, we build software to help health systems better diagnose and care for patients with genetic conditions, including rare diseases and hereditary cancer risk. Backed by top Canadian investors and leading healthcare institutions across Canada and the UK, our platform powers genomic medicine for hospitals, clinics, and researchers worldwide.

We are looking for an **ML/AI Engineer** to develop and improve clinical AI/ML pipelines that power functionality within our platform, working at the intersection of natural language processing and clinical informatics to deliver models that directly help clinicians.

You will help develop a new AI\-assisted tool that supports clinicians through critical steps in genomic test ordering. You'll work in a two\-person R\&D pod alongside a Product Engineer. You'll own model development and ML infrastructure, and they'll own the clinician\-facing experience. Our broader engineering team of five is focused on the core platform and is available to support you. You'll report to the Head of Product and Engineering.

This is a high\-impact role where your ability to take models from experimentation to production will directly shape the way genetics is practiced around the world. If you thrive tackling hard problems in a pragmatic, user\-focused way and want your work to matter, we'd love to hear from you.

**Pay range**: CA$110,000–$130,000\. We understand that compensation is a large factor in evaluating opportunities. This pay range represents our target for the role, and is determined by market data, the planned responsibilities, and internal equity. Offers are usually near the midpoint, but the final amount may be adjusted based on your experience and skills.

**Seniority**

We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it. What matters is that you can take ML systems from experimentation to production reliably, and exercise sound judgment on model design, evaluation, and deployment tradeoffs in a clinical setting.

**Your role:**

*Building and improving the models*

* Build on and extend our existing NLP and concept recognition tools, including our phenotype extraction stack, to achieve functionality and performance goals.
* Combine separate tools into cohesive, production\-ready clinical AI/ML pipelines that can be reliably integrated.
* Integrate partner\-developed multimodal extensions, such as 2D/3D imaging capabilities, as the platform evolves over time.

*Shipping with quality*

* Develop and maintain endpoints that enable model outputs to be integrated into the clinician application.
* Develop and maintain validation frameworks against curated datasets so the team has clear signals on when models are improving and when they are regressing.
* Work with our DevOps team to deploy and maintain the infrastructure required to ship and operate models reliably, including versioning, containerized deployment, and monitoring.

**Our stack**

This project will be primarily in Python. Our work focuses on local models: open\-weight and self\-hosted, given the privacy and regulatory constraints of clinical data. We will lean on your expertise to inform tools and architecture as the project evolves.

**What You Bring:**

We value continuous learning and potential. If you don’t meet every requirement listed below but have a passion for technology, a desire to grow, and believe you would be a strong fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply:

* Demonstrated experience building ML pipelines end to end, ideally with production deployment experience.
* Strong experience working with local, open\-weight models, with sound judgment on model selection, fine\-tuning, and deployment tradeoffs.
* Strong NLP and concept recognition experience, with a comfort working close to the data and model internals.
* Experience working with health data, specifically clinical notes, is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable shipping code with AI development tools, with the judgment to know when the model is wrong.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and explain model behaviour clearly to non\-ML teammates.

**Bonus Points**

* Background or experience in health software, bioinformatics, or genetics.
* Familiarity with biomedical ontologies (HPO, SNOMED, or similar) and clinical concept recognition.
* Experience deploying models in privacy\-sensitive or regulated environments (PIPEDA, PHIPA, HIPAA, or similar).

**Benefits and Perks**

* Comprehensive health, drug, and dental coverage, plus a Health Spending Account and a Personal Wellness/Productivity fund to use on what matters most to you.
* We are primarily a remote\-first team with flexible schedules. We value outcomes over clock\-punching, and support genuine work\-life balance.
* A $500 stipend to help ensure you have a comfortable and ergonomic home setup.
* Paid vacation, personal/sick days, and our favorite: extended long weekends throughout the summer.
* We get together for annual company retreats to bond, brainstorm, and celebrate our wins in person.
* The opportunity to own a piece of what you’re building through our Stock Option plan.

**The Details**

* **Role:** Full\-time, permanent
* **Location:** Fully remote within Canada, or hybrid in Toronto (1\-2 days per week near MaRS).
* **Eligibility:** Must be Canadian resident and authorized to work in Canada (sorry, no sponsorship available at this time)

Are you a data engineer who takes pride in building clean pipelines, fast queries, and reliable data infrastructure?

* Demonstrable data engineering experience with a data warehouse platform.

* Significant hands\-on experience integrating APIs.

* Highly numerate: analytical and comfortable in detail.

**About our Lab**

  

Step into Diagneixa \- a cutting\-edge digital pathology environment where innovation meets purpose. Working for Diagnexia means taking a step into a forward\-thinking, digitally\-driven diagnostic laboratory at the forefront of diagnostic innovation.

  

* At the heart of our laboratory in Kidlington Oxford, is a passionate team dedicated to advancing healthcare. For you this means working alongside open, skilled colleagues who inspire growth and learning every day.
* We provide unmatched opportunities for ongoing personal and professional career development.
* You'll take on new and exciting challenges. And your professional journey will be fuelled by continual learning, amazing collaboration, and working together to make a real difference.

  


*Ready to shape the future of pathology, and grow personally and professionally? If so join us.*

 **About the role**


* Our Medical Laboratory Assistants are the operational foundation of our Diagnexia Oxford Lab Operations.
* You work across the **Histopathology laboratory functions** as directed by the daily rota, building technical competency against a structured module framework from day one.

  


**Career progression**


* At Diagneixa, our laboratory team includes senior Biomedical Scientists, Associate Practitioners, Medical Laboratory Assistants and Support Technicians.
* We’re going through a really important phase of growth and structure\-building within our laboratory.
* We have a clear, more intentional MLA model. Once that gives you proper career progression, stronger support, and more opportunity over time.
* You can see the role you're joining, understand what sits above it, and know what progression looks like from day 1

  


**Your career journey with us**


* Our MLA roles are the entry point to our Associate Practitioner (AP) pathway.
* You join at entry level Medical Laboratory Assistant (L1\), work through probation, and progress to MLA (L2\) after achieving technical competency against a predetermined and \& structured MLA module framework.
* Once MLA (L2\) role is the entry point to the Associate Practitioner pathway for those who wish to progress further
* Staff who achieve our full L2 module completion and demonstrate the quality behaviours expected at that level are eligible to be considered for the AP track. This is not automatic however, it is subject to a formal selection process and the availability of AP posts.
* You may have the opportunity to progress to BMS, subject to you holding an IBMS accredited degree.

Your progression within the role, and your salary, is directly linked to the modules you achieve sign\-off on.  
* 

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Receive, log, and label specimens, slides \& blocks; check formalin adequacy and chain of custody at the point of receipt
* Data entry and competent in the use of the LIMS and Tracking System, including its use in registration and verification of data relating to pathology specimens, slides and blocks
* Load and unload tissue processors; check reagent levels, select correct programme, monitor cycle completion
* Run routine H\&E staining; assess slide quality against defined criteria before release
* File, retrieve, and return slides and blocks; maintain storage compliance
* Carry out routine and non\-routine specimen preparation and/or analysis including assisting medical and scientific staff at dissection, and performing routine laboratory tasks, following training, such as embedding and microtomy
* Set up dissection bench; scribe and label cassettes accurately as directed by BMS during cut\-up
* Load scanners; manage batch queues; identify and report scan failures before end of session
* Raise any quality concern, discrepancy, or near\-miss to the BMS on shift — same day, every time
* Log and communicate using Freshdesk, ClickUp, and chat as required
* Ensure compliance with GDPR/CQC regulations and maintain patient records in accordance with all data protection protocols
* Respond to incoming calls, voicemails, and email tickets in a polite and supportive manner, seeking scientific staff advice where required.
* Basic troubleshooting of customer support problems

  


**Additional Areas**

  

* Track and document technical problems
* Know the limits of own practice and escalate uncertainties, concerns and technical issues to senior member of staff when appropriate

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, Department of Materials and Production one or more positions as PhD stipend in Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Systems, within the doctoral programme Materials Science, Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering, is open for appointment from 15\.08\.2026 or soon thereafter. The position is available for a period of 3 years.

  

  

**Your work tasks**



The PhD position is part of the Artificial Intelligence for Operations Research (AI4OR) group at Aalborg University. The successful candidate will engage in cutting\-edge research conducted in close collaboration with leading Danish and European companies, as well as international academic partners.



The AI4OR group addresses complex, high\-impact problems requiring advanced modelling, data analysis, and algorithmic solution development. The group focuses particularly on automated decision\-making in autonomous cyber\-physical systems, combining mathematical optimization, machine learning, and decision theory.



Autonomous systems and intelligent decision\-support solutions are transforming industry and society. However, ensuring their reliability, safety, and transparency remains a major challenge, especially in uncertain and dynamic environments. This PhD position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of trustworthy real\-time autonomous systems, where decisions are adaptive, explainable, and robust.



Collaborations with industrial and public\-sector partners will ensure that the research has direct practical relevance and impact. The project will explore the convergence of operations research, machine learning, and decision\-making methodologies to design systems capable of functioning safely and efficiently under uncertainty.



Limited teaching within the Global Business Engineering program can be expected, as well as teaching in other study programmes at Aalborg University.

  




**Your competencies**  



We are seeking motivated and talented candidates with a solid foundation in AI methods and mathematics, and a keen interest in developing the next generation of autonomous decision\-making systems.



You should be able to use your background to develop decision\-making strategies that integrate operations research techniques and AI, engineer robust and adaptive solution systems, and address challenges related to multi\-agent coordination and decision\-making under uncertainty.



The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in creating transparent, trustworthy, and data\-driven methods that improve the reliability and adaptability of autonomous systems. You are expected to disseminate your results through high\-impact journals and conferences, and to collaborate actively with industrial and public partners to bridge academic research and real\-world applications.



In addition, the candidate should demonstrate proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or similar.

  

  

**Qualification requirements**



PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree in Operations Research, Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1039 of August 27, 2013 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time.

  

  

**Who we are**


The AI4OR group operates at the intersection of AI / machine learning and operations research / optimization. The group engages in both methodological development (novel algorithms, hybrid AI–OR techniques, data\-driven optimization) and applied problem solving (industrial case studies, logistics, routing, maintenance planning, autonomous/mobile systems). Through close cooperation with leading academic and industry partners, the group emphasizes bridging theory and practice. The group has more than 20 full time researchers, access to state\-of\-the\-art\-facilities and strong international collaborations with world leading entities.



The Department of Materials and Production (MP) is a wide\-ranging research and educational environment at Aalborg University. The Department's mission is to meet the future's demands for new materials and production systems by directing the whole value chain from basic material understanding to materials' applications in mechanical construction, industrial production, and management. The department has several strong, international, and innovative research groups that comprise everything from basic science to strategic and applied research. The activities encompass research and education within materials, mechanics, physics, production, and industrial management and innovation.



Several innovative and unconventional collaborations have been and are being developed through interdisciplinary cooperation, benefiting the industry and additional collaborators. As an employee at the department, you will become part of an international research environment focusing on innovation, knowledge sharing/building, and interdisciplinary collaborations.



The Department’s activities are supported by world\-class laboratories and an important part of the research being done at the department. Specifically in relation to this position we have facilities for synthesis and characterization of materials covering the range from the atomic scale in the cleanroom and materials labs to fabrication of components and devices.

  

  

**How to apply**  

Your application must include the following:



* Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
* Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* Transcripts and diplomas (bachelor's and, if possible, master's degree diploma)
* Brief description (maximum 1 page) of your motivation for the project(s) (stipend(s))
* List of publications (if applicable)
* Other relevant documents


The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.



Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

  

  

**Do you have any questions?**  

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

  


  

**Further information**  




The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
  

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.



The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.



Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

  

  

**Salary and terms of employment**  

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).



Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish)
  

  

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real\-world\-oriented education and create world\-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** **Senior AI Engineer**


**Reports to:** **Head of AI**


**Location:** **Ireland \- Remote**

 **The Challenge**



Would you like to revolutionize how global companies navigate complex regulatory landscapes? Are you excited about building AI systems that transform traditional compliance processes into intelligent, automated solutions? We're seeking a Senior AI Engineer to help us transition from traditional software\-as\-a\-service to results\-as\-a\-service in the compliance space.

 **The Opportunity**



As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge AI technologies to solve real\-world compliance challenges. You'll work with a team dedicated to building AI\-powered solutions that help global enterprises understand, manage, and automate their compliance processes across multiple markets and jurisdictions.

 **Core Responsibilities:**


* Product Development \& Innovation:
	+ Identify and implement opportunities where AI can create tangible value for our customers in their compliance journey.
	+ Design and develop production\-grade AI solutions that automate complex compliance tasks.
	+ Build and optimize advanced NLP models for regulatory document analysis and interpretation
	+ Contribute to finding the right ML framing of compliance challenges
	+ Create scalable AI systems that can handle diverse regulatory requirements across different markets.
* Technical Leadership
	+ Take algorithms from proof\-of\-concept to production, ensuring robustness and scalability.
	+ Establish processes for large\-scale data analysis, model development, validation, and deployment.
	+ Build and maintain ML infrastructure that can evolve with our growing needs.
	+ Implement monitoring systems to track model performance and compliance accuracy.
	+ Ensure our AI solutions maintain high standards of explainability and ethical considerations.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
	+ Work closely with product managers and compliance experts to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
	+ Partner with engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into our core platform.
	+ Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing.
	+ Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision\-making.

  

  



**Key Skills that we are looking for:**


* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in production environments, with a strong industry track record of designing and architecting distributed systems.
* Proficient in Python with extensive experience in developing and deploying production\-grade software, utilizing machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
* Deep understanding of engineering and infrastructure best practices with a focus on the machine learning software development lifecycle.
* Extensive experience working with modern deep learning techniques, LLMs, and advanced NLP architectures building data intensive applications
* Experience with techniques for optimizing ML inference performance.
* Hands\-on expertise in designing, developing, and managing batch and real\-time ML pipelines/workflows for processing complex structured and unstructured data on AWS, utilizing SageMaker, ECS, EKS, Airflow and related tools.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within engineering teams and across various disciplines.

  


**About us:**



Compliance \& Risks provides global companies with the tools, insights, and expertise to build safe, sustainable products. With two decades of experience, we help monitor, assess, and prove compliance, protecting your brand and driving growth in an evolving regulatory landscape.



The company serves over 320\+ global enterprise customers including: GE, Google, Nike, Amazon, Bose, Tesla, Vaillant, Unisys, Samsung and Fujitsu.

 **We take pride in what we build**



We are a product company. We understand the impact our product has on the world and for our company. We watch it iterate, evolve, grow. We can easily connect the code we write to the problems we are solving for companies who are trying to build and sell their products in the global market. Whether it’s a hoodie, a car or a laptop, we can see our code helping to get that product to the high street.

 **We take pride in how we build**



Our self organizing teams make the decisions in how they architect, implement and deliver the code that they write. We support the decisions they bring, and trust our teams to present the options that make most sense for the company, the team and for the growth of the individuals.

  

We are a diverse team in Compliance \& Risks and we are committed to building and promoting an inclusive place to work for everyone. We strive to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We aim to increase the diversity of our employee base by growing our diverse talent pipeline, including partnerships with organizations like Resilient Coders, Women who code, Women in Tech. We are committed to equality of opportunity for all employees, by promoting a work environment free from bullying, discrimination or harassment. Compliance \& Risks is an equal opportunities employer.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer (Node.js / Next.js / TypeScript) to join our team and help advance our AI infrastructure. You'll work within a modern tech stack, focusing on model performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.


You'll take ownership of prompt systems, structured outputs, and LLM workflows built on LangChain or LlamaIndex. The role also covers observability and evaluation using Langfuse and AI gateways such as OpenRouter, with the goal of consistently improving model quality and operational efficiency. You'll drive key AI features from early experimentation all the way through to production.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Advanced Prompt Engineering: Designing complex, dynamic prompt templates with conditional logic and efficiently reusing information and context within prompts to maximize generation quality and reasoning.
* Structured Outputs \& Schemas: Implementing various response schemes (JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas) to ensure AI outputs are predictable and ready for seamless integration into application logic.
* Prompt Engineering \& Evaluations: Building robust evaluation pipelines and using Langfuse to collect feedback and score the quality of responses in real time.
* Tracing \& Debugging: Performing deep debugging of complex LLM chains using Langfuse traces to identify bottlenecks and optimize for cost, latency, and context window usage.
* AI A/B Testing: Running systematic experiments across different models via OpenRouter (e.g., comparing Claude 3\.5 Sonnet vs. GPT\-4o) and analyzing results based on quantitative metrics.
* Data\-Driven Decisions: Making deployment decisions for new prompts or models strictly based on quantitative benchmarks and trace data, rather than intuition.
* Output Scoring \& Analysis: Developing scoring systems to analyze the “Problem Solution” chain and identify root causes of hallucinations or logic errors using Langfuse analytics.
* Model Performance \& Fine\-Tuning: Regularly re\-evaluating model performance as new architectures emerge and performing fine\-tuning when necessary to meet specific domain requirements.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Node.js \& Next.js: Deep knowledge of the stack to build reliable services and handle complex LLM\-generated data.
* Dynamic Prompting Skills: Proven experience in building prompts where content is highly dependent on input variables and context injection.
* OpenRouter Experience: Experience working with unified APIs, managing rate limits, and selecting the most cost\-effective models for specific tasks.
* Langfuse (or similar): Understanding of LLM observability principles — setting up tracing, creating test datasets, and integrating scoring systems.
* Evaluation Methodology: Experience with frameworks like RAGAS or building custom “LLM\-as\-a\-judge” systems.
* Analytical Mindset: Ability to transform raw generation logs into actionable business metrics and technical insights.
* Iterative Mindset: Focus on continuous product improvement through constant feedback loops.
* Fluency in Russian and/or Ukrainian.

**Nice to have**
================

* Fine\-Tuning: Practical experience in fine\-tuning models for specific domain tasks or JSON compliance.
* RAG Architecture: Understanding how to build and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation systems, including indexing, retrieval, and re\-ranking.
* Python: Basic knowledge for working with data science scripts or AI evaluation libraries.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (30 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**About Brightly**
 Brightly is a global leader in intelligent, cloud‑based asset lifecycle management, empowering 12,000\+ clients with predictive insights to optimize maintenance, energy, and capital planning—backed by Siemens. Our products help schools, hospitals, cities, and manufacturers keep critical infrastructure running efficiently and sustainably.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead LLM‑powered application development—from prototype to production—on AWS. You’ll design robust ML/LLM services that power search, recommendations, copilots, and workflow automation in Brightly’s platform, partnering closely with product, data, and engineering teams. Responsibilities and skill expectations reflect current industry practice for senior ML/LLM engineers, including end‑to‑end model lifecycle ownership, production‑grade code, and MLOps.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build LLM applications: Design and implement RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, tools/agents, safety/guardrails, and evaluation harnesses; instrument for latency, cost, and quality. (Guided by current LLM engineer role practices.)
* Own the ML lifecycle: Data curation, feature engineering, training/fine‑tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), A/B testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of models and prompts.
* Productionize on AWS: Ship scalable services on EKS/ECS/Lambda; leverage SageMaker, Bedrock, EMR, MSK, Step Functions; apply observability (CloudWatch/OpenTelemetry) and cost controls. (Duties aligned to modern AWS ML roles.)
* Scale training \& inference: Use distributed training (FSDP/DeepSpeed), quantization, caching, vector databases, and GPU/Inferentia for performance and efficiency.
* MLOps \& governance: Establish CI/CD for models (MLflow/Kedro/SageMaker Pipelines), model/version registries, data and prompt lineage, evaluation gates, and responsible‑AI controls. (Aligned with contemporary MLOps templates.)
* Partner across Brightly: Translate asset‑management use cases into ML/LLM solutions; collaborate with product managers and UX to ship customer‑visible features that measurably improve reliability, safety, and sustainability.
* Mentor \& lead: Provide technical leadership, review designs/PRs, and raise the bar on ML engineering excellence across the team. (Common senior ML expectations.)
* Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, correlations, feature importance, and data quality issues.


 (Consistent with ML engineer responsibilities to analyze data before model development.)
   

  

* Conduct deep research on asset\-related, operational, and domain\-specific datasets to understand root causes, trends, and predictive signals.


**What You’ll Bring**
**Required experience**
* 5–7 years total software/ML engineering experience, with 3\+ years building and operating ML systems in production.
* 1\+ years hands‑on LLM application development (e.g., RAG, fine‑tuning, prompt engineering, evaluators/guardrails, agentic workflows) using packages such as Langchain and Langgraph.
* AWS proficiency (3\+ years): Strong with core services (EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB/RDS, Step Functions, IAM) and ML stack (SageMaker, Bedrock or HF on AWS). (Representative AWS ML role skills.)
* Modeling \& frameworks: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem; vector stores (e.g., OpenSearch, PGVector, Pinecone), embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation metrics for NLP/LLMs. (In line with senior LLM roles.)
* MLOps: CI/CD for ML, model registries, experiment tracking, telemetry/monitoring, automated retraining; Docker/Kubernetes, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI. (Current MLOps expectations.)
* Data engineering fluency: ETL/ELT, streaming/batch (Spark/Flink), data quality and governance controls for ML.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed), RLHF, or Inferentia/Trainium optimization.
* Exposure to sustainability/asset/intelligent operations domains.
* Familiarity with security \& compliance for ML systems in enterprise environments. (Frequently included in senior ML roles.)


 How you’ll work
